scope: Retained six-case completed pilot, independent raw fixture calculation; no model calls or relabelling.
profile_definition: Union of rejection reasons among same-key candidate records for unknown requirements on unrefuted routes. Historical fallback blockers are included. Profiles are disjoint descriptions, not additive causal-effect estimates.
